game_identity.title: TBD
game_identity.core_loop: Avoid/outlast hostile entities in a bounded arena; survive as long as possible
game_identity.v1_status: Shipped in engine Step 12 - one player, one hostile, AABB catch detection, survival timer (console only), MENU/PLAYING/PAUSED/GAME_OVER state machine

phases.name: Multiple Hostiles
phases.definition_of_done: 2-3+ hostiles simultaneously chase the player, added as entity-vector data (push_back), reusing existing update/draw/collision loops with zero new code paths
phases.notes: Three hostiles total: two push_backs before the initialEntities snapshot (spawn points (3,2) CW spin and (-3,2) faster CCW spin beside the original (0,-2)), parallel const float hostileSpeeds[] {1.8, 1.6, 1.5} mapped by index h-3 — all slower than the player's 2.5 so escape stays possible (Step 12 principle). Chase generalized to a loop over indices 3..N-1 using the same four Step 5 Vec3 ops per hostile; catch test generalized to a loop OR-ing Step 8's aabbOverlap into one bool — ANY hostile ends the run through the identical Step 12 death block. Scenery pair loop bound untouched; resetGame() needed ZERO changes (snapshot/restore absorbs the new entities). CMakeLists.txt and gamestate.h unchanged (pure logic, no new states). Fresh clean rebuild passed first try, zero engine warnings. Verified by user: independent tracking at varied speeds, scenery/each-other pass-through, identical lose flow, all six entities freeze on pause, full reset correct.

phases.name: Difficulty Scaling
phases.definition_of_done: Hostile speed and/or spawn rate increases with survivalTime, using deltaTime-driven state rather than fixed constants
phases.notes: Low-risk flavor: existing hostiles speed up, no new entities. effectiveSpeed = baseSpeed * min(1 + survivalTime * 0.01, 1.33) applied at usage time in the chase loop; hostileSpeeds[] stays a const base array (never mutated), cap binds at 33 s with fastest hostile topping out at 2.394 < player 2.5 (Step 12 avoidable-by-construction holds at any run length). Driver is Step 12's survivalTime reused — PLAYING-gated so pausing freezes difficulty (no wall-clock leak); resetGame() needed ZERO changes. Same commit also shipped balance tuning (not a separate phase): arena widened to ortho (-6..6, -4.5..4.5) keeping exact 4:3 (no stretching, 66.7 px per world unit), and the three hostiles pass explicit halfExtents (0.5, 0.5) — disclosed deviation from Step 8's 0.7071 rotation-safe bound (that guarantee serves spinning scenery, not chasing hostiles); player and scenery hitboxes untouched at 0.7071. Only new include <algorithm>; CMakeLists.txt/gamestate.h/entity.h/collision.h unchanged. Fresh clean rebuild, zero engine warnings. Verified by user: correct 4:3 arena, near-misses survive while scenery tint/beep unchanged, ramp correct over ~30 s and capped, pause leak-free, reset restores base speed.

phases.name: On-Screen Text (Score/Timer Display)
phases.definition_of_done: Survival time visible on screen during PLAYING and on GAME_OVER, not console-only. First new engine capability required post-Step-12 (text/font rendering).
phases.notes: Digit-only bitmap font (glyphs 0-9 + '.'), built ourselves — eleven hand-coded 5x7 patterns beat a text library for this scope. Atlas: 176x16 RGBA PNG, one row of eleven 16x16 cells, generated in-tree by make_font.ps1 using make_checker.ps1's exact hand-written PNG machinery (only difference: IHDR color type 6 RGBA for per-pixel alpha). Rendering: NO second render system — same Step 4/10 shader, same interleaved layout, one new VAO/VBO (GL_DYNAMIC_DRAW, six vertices re-uploaded per glyph with cell UV baked); blending scoped to the text block; sole shader change is fragment alpha passthrough vec4(texel.rgb*color, texel.a) (checker alpha always 1.0, so all existing draws unaffected). Screen-space = projection x model WITHOUT the view matrix; no second projection needed (existing ortho box doubles as the screen rectangle); deliberate v-flip on cell UVs (stb decodes top-down); color uniform reset to white before text. Timer formatted via ostringstream/fixed/setprecision(1); live on PLAYING, frozen on GAME_OVER, hidden on MENU; console backup retained. No CMakeLists.txt change (empty git diff). Fresh clean rebuild (configure 627.8 s), zero engine warnings, exe 813,056 bytes, main.cpp 1,216 -> 1,425 lines. Verified by user: MENU clean, live readable digits top-left (not upside-down), window-fixed during WASD pan, pause freezes the number, stays white during collision tint, on-screen and console final times match, reset returns to '0.0'.

phases.name: Scoring Beyond Survival Time
phases.definition_of_done: Either a defined additional scoring mechanic is implemented and displayed, or a deliberate decision is recorded that survival time alone is sufficient
phases.notes: Decision recorded: survival time REMAINS the score metric — Phase 4 delivers PERSISTENCE instead: the best time survives as a high score, the engine's first disk-WRITE capability (Steps 9/10 only read). Save: plain-text savedata/highscore.txt, one decimal number (single float — no JSON structure, no binary need, Notepad-verifiable). Load once at startup via the same 3-candidate CWD probe as Steps 9/10; found path remembered so the save never forks; missing file defaults to 0.0 (normal first run, NOT a hard failure like a missing asset); garbage parse fails safe to the default. Write at GAME_OVER on STRICT greater-than only, in-memory record first (display stays correct even if I/O fails), std::filesystem::create_directories with the no-throw error_code overload, checked open AND checked output after flush; failure = console warning, never fatal. Display: ZERO new rendering mechanics — Phase 3's glyph loop extracted unchanged into drawDigitString(); second row at (-5.75, 3.2) below the live timer (-5.75, 4.05), position-only distinction, same non-MENU gate. resetGame() zero changes — high score is meta-game state outside the snapshot. New includes <fstream>/<filesystem>; CMakeLists.txt unchanged (empty diff). .gitignore gained savedata/ in the same commit (runtime save state; folder self-creates; fresh clones start at 0.0). Fresh clean rebuild (configure 647.2 s) first try, zero engine warnings, exe 838,144 bytes, main.cpp 1,425 -> 1,565 lines. Verified via commit authorization: game-created savedata/ observed at build\Release\savedata, record persisted and displayed, staged list proved the ignore rule (exactly src/main.cpp + .gitignore, save file absent).

phases.name: Content Pass
phases.definition_of_done: Player, hostiles, and arena visually distinct from each other and from Step 4-10 placeholder checkerboard geometry
phases.notes: Approach (a): per-type in-tree textures over tint-only. make_textures.ps1 (same hand-written PNG machinery as make_checker.ps1) generates three 16x16 RGB PNGs — tex_player.png warm green, tex_scenery.png steel blue, tex_hostile.png crimson; threat readable from decoration at a glance. TINT RULE: every color keeps red-channel content or it would render black under the Step 8 red tint (hostiles never tinted, crimson free). loadRgbTexture lambda extracts the checker's load/upload pattern, called 3x with the 3-candidate probe; textures join all cleanup chains; draw loop binds per entity index (0=player, 1..2=scenery, 3+=hostiles) — the seam Step 12's comment deferred, zero shader/sampler/pipeline change; checker kept loaded as unsampled legacy. Collision tint, beep edges, difficulty ramp, Phase 3/4 UI untouched.

phases.name: Packaging
phases.definition_of_done: Exe + assets runnable on a clean machine without dev environment installed, or a documented clean-checkout build process
phases.notes: Both halves of the definition of done met: README.md at repo root (project intro, EXACT two CMake commands, run instructions, controls, asset-generator table, standalone layout) AND a truly standalone exe. Honest DLL audit: everything static except MSVC /MD runtime DLLs (VCRUNTIME140/MSVCP140) — fixed by static CRT. First attempt (CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY+CMP0091) failed silently because fetched deps reset the policy scope; replaced with scope-proof /MD->/MT flag-variable rewrite (25 lines in CMakeLists.txt). Verified: dumpbin /DEPENDENTS lists only KERNEL32/USER32/GDI32/SHELL32; exe launched from a bare folder with only itself + assets/ (no savedata/) and passed every startup check. Exe 838,144 -> 1,170,432 bytes. Package = exe + assets/; savedata/ ships empty (fresh installs start at 0.0). Fresh configure 757.9 s, clean build first try, zero engine warnings; main.cpp 1,565 -> 1,675 lines. Shipped with Phase 5 in one combined pass — GAME BUILD COMPLETE, 6/6 phases.

kill_criteria: If any phase's scope keeps expanding instead of shrinking, stop, cut scope, and re-record a smaller definition_of_done before continuing.
